Libraries & services

  • SurveyJS Form Library — MIT licensed, used to render the survey form.

  • Google Sheets and Google Apps Script — Google Sheets is used to store survey responses, and Google Apps Script is used to automate data handling and integration workflows. They follow Google’s own terms of service, not this site’s license.

Privacy & data handling

If you fill out the survey on this site, here’s what happens to it:

  • Responses are treated as anonymous — the collected responses are not linked to individual participants or used to identify respondents.
  • Storage — responses are stored via Google Sheets/Google Apps Script, which functions as a data processor with technical access to what’s submitted.
  • No public sharing or sale — data isn’t shared publicly or sold to third parties. Note that Google, as the storage provider, isn’t the same as “no external party has access”; this section will be updated if the backend changes.
